about_subtitle: LOC RÉACTION S.A.S supports individuals, businesses and public bodies across five complementary trades, with the same commitment to reliability and closeness to our clients.
about_mission_title: Simplifying your journeys and your projects
about_mission_text: Founded in Chaumontel, in the Val-d'Oise department, LOC RÉACTION S.A.S was built on a simple conviction: a single trusted partner can support you from everyday transport through to managing your real estate projects. We offer professional drivers, qualified technical teams and transparent management, backed by a real-time digital platform.
about_vtc_text: Our licensed drivers cover your journeys at a clear rate of €1.70/km, with live GPS tracking and professional service, for everyday trips as well as your most important appointments.
about_amo_text: We support public and private project owners in steering their projects: awarding and managing works contracts, technical and financial coordination of contractors, and subcontracting oversight through to project handover.
about_immo_text: We list and manage rental properties across the Paris region, with professional support from first contact through to handing over the keys.
about_jardin_text: Mowing, tree and shrub pruning, weeding, watering, fertilising: we design and maintain your green spaces, along with routine cleaning of buildings, façades, surrounding areas and car parks.
about_value_1_text: Clear pricing, real-time tracking, no surprises.
about_value_2_text: A local team based in Chaumontel, reachable and responsive.
about_value_3_text: Qualified teams across each of our five trades.
about_cta_text: Get in touch or request a quote directly.
